The 11 new tests pass, but worktree creation can fail after creating persistent resources, bypassing the rollback logic and blocking retries.

Review comment:

- [P2] Roll back partial failures from worktree creation — /Users/kwang/projects/headquarter.goals/goal-new/hq/src/goal.ts:23-24
  If a repository's `post-checkout` hook exits nonzero, `git worktree add` returns failure after creating the branch and registering the worktree. Because this call is outside the cleanup block, the command leaves an incomplete goal without its initial goal-file commit, and retrying fails because the branch already exists. Include worktree creation in failure handling and clean up any resources it created.
